# routeros_interface_l2tp_ether (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the L2TP ether interface.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `allow_fast_path` (Boolean) Whether to allow FastPath processing. Must be disabled if IPsec tunneling is used.
- `circuit_id` (String) The virtual circuit identifier used to bind one end of the L2TPv3 control channel.
- `comment` (String)
- `connect_to` (String) Remote address of the L2TP server.
- `cookie_length` (String) Length of the L2TPv3 pseudowire static session cookie.
- `digest_hash` (String) The hash function used by the L2TPv3 control channel.
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `ipsec_secret` (String, Sensitive) When secret is specified, router adds dynamic IPsec peer to remote-address with pre-shared key and policy (by default phase2 uses sha1/aes128cbc).
- `l2tp_proto_version` (String) The transport the L2TPv3 pseudowire is carried over.
- `local_address` (String) Source address of the tunnel packets, local on the router.
- `local_session_id` (String) The local session identifier, an integer. Only used in unmanaged mode; RouterOS reports `disabled` when it is not set, so the value is handled as a string.
- `local_tunnel_id` (String) The local tunnel identifier, an integer. Only used in unmanaged mode; RouterOS reports `disabled` when it is not set, so the value is handled as a string.
- `mac_address` (String) MAC address of the tunnel interface.
- `mtu` (String) Layer3 Maximum transmission unit ('auto', 0 .. 65535). Look for the exact minimum value in the MikroTik documentation
- `peer_cookie` (String) Optional peer cookie. To enable the cookie, enter the remote cookie value (an 8 or 16 character hex string).
- `remote_session_id` (String) The remote session identifier, an integer. Only used in unmanaged mode; RouterOS reports `disabled` when it is not set, so the value is handled as a string.
- `remote_tunnel_id` (String) The remote tunnel identifier, an integer. Only used in unmanaged mode; RouterOS reports `disabled` when it is not set, so the value is handled as a string.
- `send_cookie` (String) Optional local cookie. To enable the cookie, enter the cookie value (an 8 or 16 character hex string).
- `unmanaged_mode` (Boolean) Activates the unmanaged (static) mode, in which the tunnel and session identifiers are configured manually instead of being negotiated by the L2TP control channel.
- `use_ipsec` (Boolean) When enabled, a dynamic IPsec peer configuration and policy are added to encapsulate the L2TP connection into an IPsec tunnel.
- `use_l2_specific_sublayer` (Boolean) Enables the default L2-specific sublayer of the L2TPv3 pseudowire.

### Read-Only

- `actual_mtu` (Number)
- `dynamic` (Boolean) Configuration item created by software, not by management interface. It is not exported, and cannot be directly modified.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `running` (Boolean)
- `unmanaged` (Boolean) Whether the interface is currently operating as an unmanaged (static) pseudowire.
